sloka: नृशम्सवृत्ते व्यसनप्रहारिणि ।प्रसह्य वाक्यम् यदिहाद्य भाषसे ।न नाम ते केन मुखात्पतन्त्यधो ।विशीर्यमाणा दशना स्सहस्रधा ॥२-१२-१०९॥
transliteration: nṛśamsavṛtte vyasanaprahāriṇi ।prasahya vākyam yadihādya bhāṣase ।na nāma te kena mukhātpatantyadho ।viśīryamāṇā daśanā ssahasradhā ॥2-12-109॥

translations.english: O cruelhearted woman, you strike one in adversity. Why are your teeth with which you are now speaking (such harsh words) do not fall to the ground, broken into a thousand fragments?
